posts.title: The best dark mode toggle is absolutely the one I have on my personal website because I say so
posts.description: I am not here to contribute to the discord about the optimal dark mode toggle design, I just want to talk about me me me. ;) Why go for two-state or tri-state when I can go for hexa-state? I had fun making these modes. Let’s break them down.

posts.title: The Case for Side Quests
posts.description: I have a ton of side projects—various Slash Pages hosted on my personal website, but side projects are not the same as side quests. Side projects focus on what you are good at, while side quests are defined as doing something you are not good at. A distinction I recently learned from a random YouTube video in my feed.
